appId.title: App Store app ID
appId.description: Numeric Apple App Store app ID (e.g. 310633997 for WhatsApp).

country.title: Store country
country.description: Two-letter country code of the App Store to query.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews
maxReviews.description: Maximum reviews to return per run (Apple caps at ~500).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: full = all recent reviews. delta = only reviews not seen in previous runs (tracked in key-value store).

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Key-value store key for delta tracking. Use one per app+country you track.
